caption.text: Part 4 of RUST OWNERSHIP. Rust does not have a garbage collector and it does not need one — a single rule about who owns what does the whole job at compile time. This handbook walks the full model: what moves, what copies, when destructors fire and in which order (locals reverse, struct fields forward — that one catches everyone), and how ownership flows through calls, closures and threads. Ten pages, every compiler error you will meet, and the fix ladder to climb when you are stuck.
